summary.text: Brett Miller is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 41 who took office on December 1, 2014, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Miller won re-election to District 41 in 2018 and 2020, defeating Michele Wherley both times, and again in 2022 and 2024, defeating Favyan Asia and Brad Chambers respectively.
Chambers, a Democrat, is again his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
Ballotpedia reports that Miller's 2014 campaign website highlighted government spending, small-business regulation, public pension reform and school finance as issues.
According to Ballotpedia's excerpt, the site said he had developed budgets at the township level and had spent nearly his entire career in public education.
